ideas.pitch: An enterprise-grade autonomous incident triage and remediation agent that parses incoming alert payloads, maps them to BPMN workflows, and executes safe remediation scripts with built-in human-in-the-loop approval gates.
ideas.title: Jarvis-BPMN: Autonomous Incident Triage and Self-Healing Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the industry-focused, problem-solving mandate of Project J.A.R.V.I.S. by solving a tangible enterprise pain point using process orchestration and agentic governance.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance semantic routing proxy that intercepts enterprise queries, calculates kNN distances over cached prompt exemplars, and dynamically routes requests between local open-weights models and high-cost frontier APIs to reduce inference latency and cost.
ideas.title: QueryRouter: Training-Free Semantic Router for Multi-Model Enterprise LLMs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning architecture of advanced routing systems by focusing on extreme efficiency and cost-saving metrics, which technical judges value highly for industry viability.

ideas.pitch: A runtime sidecar and governance platform that intercepts AI application requests, detects PII leaks, scans for prompt injection attempts, and logs immutable compliance telemetry for enterprise auditing.
ideas.title: GuardAI: Open-Source Ethical Telemetry and Policy Enforcement Layer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses critical industry concerns around AI security, compliance, and governance, offering an immediate drop-in value proposition for enterprise evaluators.

ideas.pitch: An advanced transaction monitoring prototype that constructs real-time entity-relationship graphs from streaming transaction data to flag complex money laundering topologies using graph neural networks and explainable decision trees.
ideas.title: GraphAML: Multi-Source Graph Intelligence Platform for Financial Crime Detection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines complex data structures with high-stakes domain utility (fintech AML risk detection), which showcases deep engineering capability within the 24-hour limit.

ideas.pitch: A local-first developer productivity tool that runs lightweight code auditing and security vulnerability scanning locally via on-device neural processing units (NPUs) or quantized models without sending proprietary source code to external servers.
ideas.title: SnapReview: Offline Edge-AI Code Reviewer for Secure Environments
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the strong industry demand for data privacy and secure codebases, showing awareness of hardware acceleration and local execution paradigms.
